context:
Goal: the child repos merge fast without spending Mac minutes you do not need.
Problem (money): main skips macOS on a push, so with each lane merged alone a Mac break can reach main untested; running macOS on those pushes costs more Mac minutes and a change to each repo's checks.yml.
Based on (notes): the consultant relayed this at 23:19 CST Nov 15; I did not measure the Mac minutes.
Departs from: main — main skips macOS on a push; option b keeps macOS on for a push whose head lacked the base tip.
home: step ci-batch-mac-runner and the child repos' checks.yml

options.how: Main keeps skipping macOS on a push; the nightly run tests it.
options.label: Accept the gap; the nightly run catches a Mac break
options.lose: A Mac break can sit on main for up to a day.

options.gain: Each merge is Mac-tested when it lands.
options.how: A checks.yml change keeps macos=true on such a push.
options.label: Keep macOS on for a push whose head lacked the base tip
options.lose: More Mac minutes, and a checks.yml change in each child repo.

title: Under per-lane merging in the child repos, should a Mac break be allowed to sit until the nightly run?
why: The nightly run already tests macOS, so the gap is at most one day, and it spends no extra Mac minutes (consultant's recommendation, unmeasured).
